home.intro: I design APIs, business applications and back-offices for fintech, ed-tech and teams that need maintainable software, clear technical decisions and a reliable path to production.
home.services.label: What I do
home.services.title: What I can structure and deliver
home.services.subtitle: The scope follows the problem: a documented API, a complete business tool or an existing codebase that needs to become safer to evolve.
home.services.web_text: Business applications and internal interfaces built around clear data models and understandable workflows.
home.services.saas_text: Back-offices, roles, permissions and daily operations organized around how a team actually works.
home.services.apis_text: REST APIs, integrations and exchange contracts with validation, authentication and usable documentation.
home.services.perf_text: Focused audits and refactoring: understand technical debt, prioritize risk and make future changes safer.
home.method.label: My method
home.method.title: A method built around decisions
home.method.subtitle: Each stage produces something verifiable: scope, data model, API contract, tested code or delivery documentation.
home.method.step1_text: Clarify the domain, users, constraints and scope before choosing a solution.
home.method.step2_text: Model the data, define API contracts and make the important technical trade-offs explicit.
home.method.step3_text: Build in testable slices with explicit business rules, failure paths and permissions.
home.method.step4_text: Prepare deployment, document operations and hand over a codebase that remains understandable.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: A hybrid studio focused on APIs, backend architecture and maintainable business applications.
about.narrative_p1: Every project starts with a scoping phase: understanding the business, the uses and the constraints before writing a single line of code. This step avoids surprises and aligns technical goals with business goals.
about.narrative_p2: I mainly use Laravel and its ecosystem for business products, and TypeScript, NestJS, Prisma and PostgreSQL for APIs and backend services. Tools change with the problem; clarity, testability and maintainability do not.
about.work_1: Scoping & mockups: define scope, budget and timelines.
about.work_2: Iterative development, tested and reviewed at each step.
about.work_3: Guided deployment, monitoring and post-delivery support.
about.work_4: Documentation and knowledge transfer included in the offer.
about.quote: A neglected detail today becomes technical debt tomorrow.
about.principles_title: Build with enough structure to move quickly later.
about.principle_1_text: Clarify the domain, the data and the constraints before choosing abstractions.
about.principle_2_text: Use the smallest structure that keeps the system clear, testable and evolvable.
about.principle_3_text: Document the important trade-offs so the codebase stays maintainable beyond delivery.
about.principle_4_text: Tests, deployments and checks should reduce friction instead of relying on memory.
about.availability_text: Based in Cotonou, I work remotely with teams building APIs, business applications and back-offices.
